description.narrative: This activity Development Research Uptake In Sub -Saharan Africa (DRUSSA) is a component of Development Research Uptake In Sub Saharan Africa (DRUSSA) reported by FCDO with a funding type of 111 - Not for profit organisation and a budget of £4,831,373. This project benefits Africa, regional. It works in the following sector(s): Advanced technical and managerial training.
